description: This file defines an Android Service named SecureWebServerService that manages a SecureWebServer instance, starts and stops it during service lifecycle events, and creates a persistent notification to interact with the user.

classes.name: SecureWebServerService
classes.description: An Android Service that hosts a secure web server with a persistent notification for user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes and starts the secure web server, then creates a persistent notification.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops the web server and removes the foreground notification.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null indicating binding is not supported.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a foreground notification that allows stopping the server when clicked.
